A.title: Hot Ground
A.text: The slope is steeper than it looks and the ash is hot an inch down. Keep to the dark patches. The pale ash is thin and gives way.

Y.title: Wind Corridor Marks
Y.text: The wind cuts this passage new each night. Old marks on the walls are scoured clean by morning. My own mark is a fresh one. Follow it if you are lost.

R.title: In the Caravan Wreck
R.text: Under the broken cart lies a stone with a potter's mark. It says: let the fire bake you slowly and you will not crack. Skin turned to clay shrugs off the heat.

G.title: The Ash Keeper
G.text: A shelter dug in the lee of a dune, swept clean every dawn by no one. Chalked on the wall: water jar behind the third stone. It is empty.

M.title: Do Not Listen Long
M.text: From this ledge you can hear your name called from the glass seam below. It is not your name. It is only the wind in the glass. Walk on.

O.title: Cairn of Nine
O.text: Nine stones, one for each caravan driver. Someone added a tenth. No name. Whoever left it is likely under the dune now.

U.title: A Driver's Ledger
U.text: Three camels lost. Water short by half. Salt traded for glass, a bad bargain on any road. Pay the guide before you start.

X.title: Last Mark of the Caravan
X.text: The sand here shifts into the shape of a door and back again. The caravans stopped here to rest. Their tracks go in. None come out.
